caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a high, ladder-style back composed of four curved horizontal slats. Each slat is a medium brown color with wood grain detailing. The chair has two vertical posts on either side of the back, each topped with a small, rounded finial. The chair arms are also wooden, featuring a gentle curve and connecting to the front legs with turned supports. The seat is made from woven fibers, arranged in a diagonal pattern, and is a tan color contrasting with the wooden frame. The legs are turned wood, displaying rounded and bulbous shapes, and connected by horizontal stretchers for stability, including a decorative central stretcher at the front. The background is light beige or off-white, and the drawing is signed “H. Eisman” in the lower right corner.
title: Armchair
